node.title: Exact-list bucket ownership and currency separation
node.statement: Fix a depth-t locator-prefix fiber and a support-wise first-match partition. Choosing one residual base support S0 injects every other residual support S into its canonical star-PTE record (S\S0,S0\S), of width h in [t+1,min(A,n-A)] and with equal elementary coefficients through order t. Hence a proved injection of all residual star records into a universal record ledger of size R gives a local primitive fiber bound 1+R. This is the primitive SP bucket. In contrast, t-null blocks and their staircase expansions are structured moment/pullback generators and belong to a separate Q/MT bucket; counting generators alone does not count the expanded list members. Finally, QA.22's per-pair bad-slope reserve is MCA currency and does not by itself bound a per-word list fiber. Therefore x4 needs three separately typed inputs: structured-column population, primitive-star coverage into its record ledger, and one list-side summed budget. None may be substituted for another without a proved adapter.
